halalStran.uvod: At Šeherezada, halal is not a marketing word but a firm commitment to purity, traceability and respect for tradition. All our veal and chicken comes from verified sources with a valid certificate. There is no pork and no alcohol in our kitchens.
halalStran.certObvestilo: The original certificate is displayed on the wall at both locations.
halalStran.stebriNaslov: Three firm pillars of halal safety
halalStran.stebriPodnaslov: For us, halal means a complete system of responsibility — from where each ingredient comes to how it is prepared on your plate.
halalStran.steber1Opis: There is no pork, pork fat, gelatine or a drop of alcohol on our premises. In our sauces, jufka dough and marinades we use only 100 % clean ingredients.
halalStran.steber2Opis: We use only quality veal and chicken from recognised European slaughterhouses with valid international halal certificates and precise traceability of every batch.
halalStran.steber3Opis: Separate work areas, dedicated equipment and regular staff training prevent any cross-contamination. For us, hygiene is part of both religious and culinary responsibility.
halalStran.meniNaslov: What is on our menu and what you will never find here
halalStran.meniPodnaslov: Transparency for every guest: a clear overview of the ingredients we use with pride, and of those that are strictly forbidden at Šeherezada.
halalStran.dovoljeno1Opis: Juicy döner kebab, grilled steaks, skewers and platters.
halalStran.dovoljeno2Opis: On every topped pizza (for example Pizza Klasik) we use certified turkey ham only.
halalStran.dovoljeno3Opis: Hand-made chickpea falafel, fresh vegetables, homemade sauces and sesame bread.
halalStran.dovoljeno4Opis: We do not serve alcohol and we do not use it in preparing our dishes.
halalStran.prepovedano1Opis: None of our {vseh} dishes contains pork, bacon, prosciutto or lard.
halalStran.prepovedano2Opis: We do not serve beer or wine, and there is no alcohol in our marinades, sauces, desserts or dough.
halalStran.prepovedano3Opis: All our meat comes only from verified supply chains with full traceability and oversight.
halalStran.prepovedano4Opis: We buy our ingredients and dressings from suppliers with a halal certificate.
halalStran.nadzorNaslov: How halal is officially certified in Slovenia
halalStran.nadzorPodnaslov: A halal certificate is not a one-off document on the wall but continuous inspection that guarantees the highest level of trust.
halalStran.statusOpis: Šeherezada holds an official halal certificate for preparing and serving food. The document is displayed on the wall at both our locations in Ljubljana.
halalStran.izdajateljNaslov: The official issuing body in Slovenia
halalStran.izdajateljOpis: Zavod Halal carries out expert reviews of suppliers, analyses every ingredient and regularly checks kitchen conditions. A certificate is issued only when all strict international criteria are met.

halalStran.rastlinskaOpis: Halal and plant-based eating go together beautifully. If you do not eat meat, you have plenty of choice here: crispy homemade chickpea falafel, fresh mixed salads with olive oil, fried sides and rich meat-free pizzas — all clearly marked on the menu so you can order with a light heart.

hfaq-1.q: Is all the meat at Šeherezada really 100 % halal?
hfaq-1.a: Yes, without exception. All the veal and chicken for our döner kebab, jufka wraps, platters and plates comes only from controlled European sources with valid international halal certificates. There is no uncertified meat in our kitchens.

hfaq-2.q: What kind of ham do you use on pizzas and in other dishes?
hfaq-2.a: On all our pizzas (for example Pizza Klasik) we use 100 % halal turkey ham only. No dish on the menu contains pork, prosciutto or bacon.

hfaq-3.q: Do you serve alcohol or use it in cooking?
hfaq-3.a: No. Šeherezada does not serve alcoholic drinks, and we do not use alcohol, wine or alcohol extracts in any marinade, sauce or dough.

hfaq-4.q: Are the student voucher dishes also 100 % halal?
hfaq-4.a: All {naBon} dishes on the student voucher are prepared to the same strict halal standards, from the same fresh certified meat or plant ingredients as the dishes on the regular menu.

hfaq-5.q: Where can I see the original halal certificate?
hfaq-5.a: The official halal certificate is permanently displayed in plain sight by the order counter at both our locations — Trubarjeva cesta 31 and Slovenska cesta 55 in Ljubljana.

hfaq-6.q: Are falafel and vegetarian dishes prepared separately from meat?
hfaq-6.a: Yes. Falafel and plant-based dishes are prepared under strict hygiene procedures with clean equipment, which prevents cross-contact and gives full assurance to halal, vegan and vegetarian guests alike.

boniStran.faqPodnaslov: Quick answers to the most common questions about using student vouchers at Šeherezada.

faq-1.q: Can I take the student meal away with me?
faq-1.a: Under the rules of the subsidised student meal system, a subsidised meal is intended to be eaten on the premises. You are of course welcome to order takeaway packaging at the listed packaging prices.

faq-2.q: What should I do if the terminal does not detect my phone?
faq-2.a: First check that NFC is switched on in your phone settings and that you are holding the phone right against the lower edge of the terminal, where the sensor is. If NFC does not work, you can choose Manual code entry in the Študentska prehrana app and simply read the code out to our staff.

faq-3.q: Are vouchers valid at weekends, on holidays and during breaks?
faq-3.a: Yes! Student vouchers are available on every calendar day of the year, including Saturdays, Sundays, public holidays and the summer and winter breaks.

faq-4.q: How long must pass between two vouchers on the same day?
faq-4.a: Under the rules of the system, at least {razmik} hours must pass between your first and second voucher. The system will not confirm a new meal before that interval has elapsed.

faq-5.q: Are all the student dishes 100 % halal certified?
faq-5.a: Yes, all the meat at Šeherezada is 100 % halal certified, with no pork or alcohol present. We also prepare {brezmesnih} meat-free dishes (vegetarian and vegan) on the voucher, including falafel and vegetable pizzas.

faq-6.q: What if I have used all my vouchers for this month?
faq-6.a: You can order any of our dishes at the regular menu prices. Your voucher allowance resets automatically on the first day of each new month.

sklopi.seherezada: Our food and how we make it

seh-1.odgovor: Our meat is 100 % halal, marinated for 24 hours in our own blend of oriental spices and grilled over a hot open fire, with no industrial additives.

seh-2.vprasanje: Do you bake your own flatbread?
seh-2.odgovor: Yes! We knead the dough every morning and bake each flatbread to order in our oven, just before we serve you, so it is always warm and crisp.

seh-3.vprasanje: Where are you and what are your opening hours?
seh-3.odgovor: We have two locations in the centre of Ljubljana. {ime1} on Trubarjeva 31 is open every day from {od1} to {do1}, and until {vikend1} on Fridays and Saturdays. {ime2} on Slovenska 55 is open every day from {od2} to {do2}.

diff-1.vprasanje: Is all the meat 100% halal certified?
diff-1.odgovor: Yes, all our suppliers hold official halal certificates with full traceability of the meat and strict hygiene oversight.
diff-1.vec: What halal means and how it is certified

diff-2.vprasanje: Do you have vegetarian and vegan dishes?
diff-2.odgovor: Of course! We make our own fresh falafel from chickpeas and herbs, creamy homemade hummus, and vegetable pizzas and jufka wraps.

diff-3.vprasanje: What sauces and dressings do you offer?
diff-3.odgovor: You can choose between a mild yoghurt sauce with fresh herbs, our house hot chilli sauce and a sesame tahini sauce.

diff-4.vprasanje: Do you accept cards and cash?
diff-4.odgovor: We accept cash, payment cards (Visa, Mastercard, Maestro) and student vouchers through the mobile app or card.

boni-1.vprasanje: How much is the surcharge and what does the student meal include?
boni-1.odgovor: The surcharge with a valid voucher is {doplacilo}. The meal includes a main dish of your choice (kebab, pizza, burger, falafel) + fresh salad + an apple + a drink.

boni-3.vprasanje: Until what time can I use my student voucher?
boni-3.odgovor: The national student meal system accepts vouchers between {oknoOd} and {oknoDo}. Because both our locations close after midnight, the voucher is valid here until {oknoDo} — from {od1} on Trubarjeva and from {od2} on Slovenska. If you arrive later, we will serve you at the regular menu prices.

boni-2.odgovor: Of course! Call us on {telefon} and your order will be waiting for you, freshly made and hot, at the agreed time — no queueing.

zasebnost.naslov: Personal data protection and privacy policy
zasebnost.uvod: At Šeherezada we value your trust. We process your personal data in line with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (the General Data Protection Regulation — GDPR), the Slovenian Personal Data Protection Act (ZVOP-2) and applicable Slovenian law.
zasebnost.razdelek1Uvod: The controller of the personal data collected through this website or in the course of our hospitality services is:
zasebnost.poslovalnici: Trubarjeva cesta 31 and Slovenska cesta 55, Ljubljana
zasebnost.vprasanjaOdgovor: please use the email address or phone number above
zasebnost.razdelek2: 2. What personal data we collect and why
zasebnost.razdelek2Uvod: We collect and process personal data only to the extent strictly necessary for each specific purpose:
zasebnost.obrazecOpis: When you send us a message through the web form, we collect your name, email address, phone number and the content of your message. We use this data solely to prepare a reply or to confirm your enquiry.
zasebnost.prijaveOpis: When you apply for a job, we process your contact details, CV and work experience. We keep this data only for the duration of the selection process, or with your consent for future opportunities.
zasebnost.dnevnikiOpis: When you visit the website, the web server automatically records technical data (IP address, browser type, date and time of access). This data serves to keep the network secure and running smoothly.
zasebnost.boniOpis: When a student voucher is used, validation is carried out through the official state ŠOS terminal. Šeherezada does not store your personal student data in its own systems.
zasebnost.qrNaslov: QR codes on printed materials and in our restaurants
zasebnost.qrOpis: Some of our QR codes (e.g. on flyers or tables) first take you to a short link seherezada.net/q/… and immediately redirect you onward (e.g. to our Google reviews). When this happens we record the date and time of the scan, an approximate location (country, region, city) that our hosting provider derives from the IP address, the type and model of the device, the operating system, the browser and the device language. We do not store the IP address; to count distinct visitors we only use a pseudonymous identifier that changes every day, so you cannot be tracked across days. We do not set any cookies. The same applies to our link pages (seherezada.net/links/…): when you press a button there, the link goes through the same short link and is recorded in the same way. We use this data only for aggregate statistics on how often and where our QR codes and buttons are used. After the redirect, the privacy policy of the destination site applies.
zasebnost.razdelek3Uvod: We process your personal data on the following legal bases under Article 6 of the GDPR:
zasebnost.podlaga1: • Performance of a contract or pre-contractual steps (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR): Processing food orders and replies to enquiries.
zasebnost.podlaga2: • Explicit consent (Article 6(1)(a) GDPR): For optional cookies and for keeping a CV for future positions. We do not send email newsletters.
zasebnost.podlaga3: • Legitimate interests (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR): To keep IT systems secure, prevent misuse, improve how the website performs and measure the use of our QR codes (aggregate scan statistics).
zasebnost.razdelek4: 4. Your rights regarding your personal data
zasebnost.razdelek4Uvod: Under the GDPR you have the following rights at any time:
zasebnost.pravicaDostopOpis: You have the right to obtain confirmation of whether we process your data, and to request free access to it.
zasebnost.pravicaPopravekOpis: You may request that inaccurate personal data be corrected without delay, or that incomplete data be completed.
zasebnost.pravicaIzbrisOpis: You may request that your data be erased (the “right to be forgotten”) where there is no longer a legal reason to keep it.
zasebnost.pravicaOmejitevOpis: You have the right to request that processing be temporarily restricted, in the event of an objection or while accuracy is being verified.
zasebnost.pravicaPrenosOpis: You may receive the data you provided to us in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format.
zasebnost.pravicaUgovorOpis: You may object at any time to processing based on legitimate interest, or withdraw consent you have given.
zasebnost.uveljavljanje: You can exercise all of the rights above with a simple written message to {eposta}. We will respond to your request without undue delay, and within 30 days at the latest.
zasebnost.varnost1: To protect your data we use up-to-date technical and organisational measures, including encrypted connections (SSL/TLS certificate), secure server protocols and limited access for authorised staff only.
zasebnost.varnost2: We keep data only for as long as is necessary for the purpose for which it was collected, or until you withdraw your consent, or until the statutory retention periods for business records expire.
zasebnost.varnost3: Records of QR code scans are kept for 24 months and are then deleted automatically. For attempts to sign in to the protected part of the website, we keep only a hashed (irreversibly transformed) form of the IP address, for no longer than 24 hours, to prevent password guessing.
zasebnost.razdelek6Uvod: We do not sell your personal data and we do not pass it on for advertising. To run this website, however, we work with providers that process data on our instructions:
zasebnost.gostovanje: • Vercel (Vercel Inc.) — our hosting provider; the servers that handle requests are in Frankfurt (EU). With every visit it records the technical data needed to deliver the page (IP address, browser type, time of request), and when a QR code is scanned it derives an approximate location from the IP address. We do not use this data to analyse visits to the website. Any transfer to the USA is safeguarded by the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.
zasebnost.razkritje: Beyond that, we disclose data only where required to do so by law or by a competent public authority.
zasebnost.razdelek7: 7. Supervisory authority in the Republic of Slovenia
zasebnost.razdelek7Uvod: If you believe that the processing of your personal data breaches applicable law, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the competent supervisory authority:
zasebnost.nadzorniOrgan: Information Commissioner of the Republic of Slovenia
zasebnost.zemljevid: • Google Maps — the Contact and Locations pages have a Google map embedded in them. It loads only after you consent, or when you click the button in its place. Google Ireland Ltd. then displays the map, receives your IP address in the process and sets its own cookies. We do not use the map to analyse visits.
zasebnost.posta: • Zoho Mail — a message you send us through the contact form travels via the e-mail provider Zoho, where our mailbox is hosted. The account is in Zoho's European data centre, so the data does not leave the European Union. In doing so Zoho processes your name, e-mail address, phone number and the content of your message.
zasebnost.baza: • Supabase (Supabase Inc.) — the records of QR code scans described in section 2 are stored in a database with this provider, in its data centre in Frankfurt (EU). Any access from the USA is safeguarded by the EU Standard Contractual Clauses.

piskotkiStran.uvodZacetek: We respect your privacy on the Šeherezada website.
piskotkiStran.uvodZAnalitiko: We use a cookie that remembers your choice and one that remembers the language of the page. Analytics cookies and the embedded map load only if you consent. We do not use advertising cookies.
piskotkiStran.uvodBrezAnalitike: What loads at the moment is only the cookie for your choice and the cookie for the page language. Analytics is not switched on yet; when it is, it will load only for visitors who chose “Accept all” in the banner. The embedded map loads only after you consent, or when you click on it yourself. We do not use advertising cookies and we do not track your behaviour.
piskotkiStran.razdelek1: 1. What cookies are and why we need them
piskotkiStran.kajSo1: Cookies are small text files that a website stores in your browser when you visit. On each return visit the site recognises the cookie and adapts the content or keeps your settings (for example your chosen language, your consent or your preferred location).
piskotkiStran.kajSo2: Cookies themselves contain no programs and cannot damage your device. They do not collect your personal data without your explicit consent.
piskotkiStran.razdelek2: 2. The types of cookies we use
piskotkiStran.razdelek2Uvod: Under the Slovenian Electronic Communications Act (ZEKom-2) and the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), cookies fall into three basic categories. Alongside them there are cookies set by embedded third-party content.
piskotkiStran.nujniOpis: These cookies are necessary for the website to work at all (security, navigation, storing your consent). By law no consent is required to set them, because the site cannot function without them.
piskotkiStran.funkcionalniOpis: They store a setting the site needs to display correctly — in our case the language you are reading in. Without it, links could take you back into a different language.
piskotkiStran.analiticniOpis: We use these to follow site traffic anonymously (page views, which dishes are most popular). IP addresses are anonymised and the data is used only in aggregate form.
piskotkiStran.razdelek3: 3. List of cookies on this website
piskotkiStran.razdelek3Uvod: The table below lists every cookie that may be placed on your device. The “Status” column tells you whether a cookie is actually in use right now — so you can see what is happening on your device today, and what is only planned:
piskotkiStran.namenNujni: Remembers your cookie choice so the banner does not ask again on every visit.
piskotkiStran.namenAnaliticni: Anonymous counting of visits and page views, so we know which parts of the site are useful to guests. Loaded only if you choose “Accept all” in the banner.
piskotkiStran.razdelek4Uvod: You can change your choice here at any time. The change takes effect immediately and is stored in the cookie
piskotkiStran.nujniVednoVklopljen: The essential cookie is always on — without it the site could not remember your choice.
piskotkiStran.razlagaZAnalitiko: Analytics cookies are loaded only if you chose “Accept all”. If you choose “Essential only”, they are not loaded and existing ones are not used.
piskotkiStran.razlagaBrezAnalitike: Analytics is not switched on yet, so for now your choice does not change what is loaded. It counts in advance, though: when we introduce analytics, it will load only for visitors who chose “Accept all” here.
piskotkiStran.razdelek5: 5. How to manage or delete cookies in your browser
piskotkiStran.razdelek5Uvod: You can also change your cookie settings at any time in your web browser. Most browsers let you refuse or accept all cookies, accept only certain types, or warn you when a site wants to store a cookie.
piskotkiStran.navodilaNaslov: How to manage cookies in popular browsers:
piskotkiStran.navodilaChrome: • Google Chrome: Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies and other site data.
piskotkiStran.navodilaFirefox: • Mozilla Firefox: Settings → Privacy & Security → Cookies and Site Data.
piskotkiStran.navodilaSafari: • Apple Safari: Settings → Privacy → Manage Website Data.
piskotkiStran.navodilaEdge: • Microsoft Edge: Settings → Site permissions → Cookies and site data.
piskotkiStran.opozorilo: Please note: if you disable cookies entirely, some parts of the website may not work as well.
piskotkiStran.razdelek6Uvod: The controller of this website and of the data collected through cookies is:
piskotkiStran.namenJezik: Records the language of the page you are viewing, so that links keep you in the same language. It is set automatically when the page loads.
piskotkiStran.namenZemljevid: Cookies set by Google once you load the map. Their names and lifetimes are not ours to decide.
piskotkiStran.analiticniOpisBrez: They are meant for anonymous measurement of site traffic. We do not use them at the moment — analytics is not switched on yet. When it is, it will load only for visitors who choose “Accept all” in the banner.
piskotkiStran.tretjaOsebaOpis: The Contact and Locations pages have a Google map embedded in them. It does not load on its own: until you choose “Accept all” or click the button in its place, Google learns nothing about you. Once you load it, Google displays the map and sets its own cookies — exactly as if you had opened the map on Google directly. Because we do not set them, we list them in the table below as one entry, without names or lifetimes.
